_note: Closes the v1/v2 gap: Throat (Vishuddha), Third Eye (Ajna), and Crown (Sahasrara) had no chakra-specific assessment questions anywhere in the knowledge base (source document advanced_questioning_techniques.txt ends mid-sentence at exactly this point in both the original upload and the RAG_documents re-upload -- confirmed identical placeholder text in both, so this could not be sourced from existing material and was authored fresh for this pass, matching the structure and neutrality standard of Root/Sacral/Solar Plexus/Heart's existing rag/assessment_technique/chakra_specific_questioning_*.md files). Every question investigates the underlying psychological/emotional/behavioural experience -- none names a chakra or asserts an imbalance to the patient, per gap-filling instruction 3 (do not lead the patient). Crown-chakra questions carry an explicit opt-in gate (CQ-CRN-05) and are marked optional/non-assumed per instruction 3D. All questions are 'therapist_review_required' -- authored to spec, not clinically piloted.
does_not_diagnose: These questions must never be used to diagnose depression, anxiety disorder, psychosis, ADHD, PTSD, or any other clinical condition (gap-filling instruction 3F). Clinically relevant disclosures should route to the existing clinical-context workflow, not be resolved via chakra questioning.

questions.question: How comfortable are you expressing what you really think or feel?
questions.purpose: Assess general comfort with authentic self-expression, without naming the chakra.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: Is there anything you often want to say but hold back?

questions.question: Is there anything you often want to say but hold back?
questions.purpose: Surface suppressed communication as a candidate Throat-domain indicator.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: What usually stops you from saying it?

questions.question: How easy is it for you to ask for what you need?
questions.purpose: Assess assertiveness/need-expression, a core Throat-domain theme.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: Can you think of a recent time you needed something and didn't ask?

questions.question: Do you generally feel heard when communicating with others?
questions.purpose: Assess the patient's felt experience of being listened to/understood.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: What does it feel like when you don't feel heard?

questions.question: How comfortable are you expressing yourself when there is disagreement?
questions.purpose: Assess communication style specifically under interpersonal conflict.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: Do you tend to go quiet, or do you speak up, when you disagree with someone?

questions.question: How often do you feel you can be your authentic self around others?
questions.purpose: Assess authenticity/self-censorship as a Throat-domain theme.

questions.question: How easy is it for you to maintain concentration?
questions.purpose: Assess general attentional capacity without asserting a clinical attention disorder.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: What usually makes it difficult for you to focus?

questions.question: When you do notice your focus slipping, what tends to be going on around you or in your mind?
questions.purpose: Identify situational/emotional/environmental disruptors of focus, WITHOUT presupposing the patient regularly struggles to focus (previous wording 'What usually makes it difficult for you to focus?' presumed the difficulty existed) -- this revised wording is conditional on CQ-AJN-01's answer rather than asserted upfront.
questions.gap_review_fix: Reworded 2026 gap-closure QA pass: original phrasing was mildly leading (presupposed difficulty existed). Should ideally only be asked as a follow-up to CQ-AJN-01 if that answer indicates some difficulty, not asked standalone.

questions.question: How comfortable are you making important decisions?
questions.purpose: Assess decision-making confidence, a core Third-Eye-domain theme.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: Do you tend to overthink decisions after making them?

questions.question: Do you tend to overthink decisions after making them?
questions.purpose: Assess rumination/overthinking pattern specifically tied to decisions.

questions.question: How clear does your thinking usually feel?
questions.purpose: Assess self-reported mental clarity/fog as a Third-Eye-domain theme.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: What helps you think clearly when you feel uncertain?

questions.question: What helps you think clearly when you feel uncertain?
questions.purpose: Surface existing coping strategies for uncertainty/ambiguity, useful for both assessment and later activity suggestions.

questions.question: Do you currently feel that your life has meaning or purpose?
questions.purpose: Assess sense of meaning/purpose -- core Crown-domain theme -- without assuming religiosity.
follow_up_if_ambiguous: What gives you a sense of purpose at this stage of life?

questions.question: What gives you a sense of purpose at this stage of life?
questions.purpose: Open-ended follow-up allowing the patient to define purpose in their own terms.

questions.question: Have your priorities or sense of purpose changed recently?
questions.purpose: Assess recent shifts, which may correlate with life transitions or distress.

questions.question: Are there activities that give you a sense of peace or connection?
questions.purpose: Assess existing sources of peace/connection -- secular or spiritual -- without presuming which.

questions.question: Would you like your personal beliefs or spirituality to be considered as part of your assessment?
questions.purpose: Explicit opt-in gate before any spiritual/religious content is explored further -- must never be assumed.

sensitivity.note: If declined, do not raise spiritual/religious content again this session.
